# Week 11 Start/Sit Briefing -- Monday 2026-11-16

## Source and freshness
Self-generated this morning via `generate_report.py` against **live nflreadpy data only** (schedules, rosters, player stats, `load_injuries`). ESPN, Sleeper, Rotowire and FantasyPros are all proxy-blocked in this sandbox, so there is no consensus tier, no red-zone/snap-share features and no LLM news layer this run -- degraded relative to the CI-built fixture. The committed `weekly-report-week-11.json` fixture predates this roster (generated 2026-09-08) and was not used.

**No Week 11 injury data exists anywhere yet** -- `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` returns zero rows for week 11 as of 06:21 UTC Monday. That's normal; teams start filing Wednesday. Every play probability below is historical play-rate and depth only. Treat this as a roster-planning briefing, not a final-call one -- come back Wednesday for the first real signal.

## Start these ten (123.47 expected points -- sanity check passed)

| Slot | Player | Opp | Exp pts | If he plays | P(play) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Tyler Shough | at CHI (Sun) | 16.51 | 16.94 | 97.4% |
| RB | Bucky Irving | at DET (Sun) | 16.36 | 17.07 | 95.9% |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | at HOU (Thu) | 13.85 | 14.42 | 96.1% |
| WR | Tee Higgins | at WAS (Mon) | 15.17 | 15.60 | 97.2% |
| WR | Jameson Williams | vs TB (Sun) | 11.11 | 11.43 | 97.2% |
| TE | Isaiah Likely | vs JAX (Sun) | 14.58 | 15.28 | 95.5% |
| FLEX | Cam Skattebo | vs JAX (Sun) | 12.62 | 13.69 | 92.2% |
| FLEX | Sam LaPorta | vs TB (Sun) | 10.11 | 10.60 | 95.5% |
| K | Jake Bates | vs TB (Sun) | 8.20 | 8.31 | 98.7% |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | at LAC (Sun) | 4.96 | 4.96 | 100% |

**Sit:** Jalen Coker (bench WR, 9.38), Bo Nix (backup QB, 16.21 -- lost the QB tie by 0.30), plus the three bye players below.

## Changes since Saturday's briefing (Week 10, 128.12 pts)

The roster-level story this week is the **triple bye**: Matthew Stafford (LAR), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (SEA) and Drake London (ATL) are all out this week with no game -- not a model call, a schedule fact. That's three of last week's best players gone at once.

What fills the gap:
- **Bucky Irving is back from his own Week 10 bye** and walks straight into RB2, the slot that was a real, forced zero last week.
- **Cam Skattebo's hamstring cleared to Full Participation** by the end of Week 10. Combined with Irving's return freeing him from the RB slot, he moves into FLEX, clearing Jalen Coker by 3.24 points.
- **Sam LaPorta joins Isaiah Likely in the starting lineup** -- the triple bye opens enough FLEX room that both rostered TEs start together this week, something that hasn't been true recently.
- Jameson Williams slides from FLEX into a main WR slot (same roster spot, different label) now that JSN and London are both out.

QB stays Shough over Nix, but it's a near-tie (16.51 vs 16.21) and moot anyway since Stafford isn't an option this week.

## Watch list

- **Cam Skattebo** -- hamstring cleared Week 10, but soft-tissue issues recur. No Week 11 row yet. Check Wednesday.
- **Tee Higgins** -- groin issue was clear by Week 10's end. His game is Monday night, the latest lock of the week, so there's time either way.
- **Jonathan Taylor** -- plays Thursday 11/19, three days ahead of the rest of the roster. Any news on him has to be acted on before this week's Wednesday report would normally land.

## Opponent notes

- **Higgins (CIN at WAS):** implied team total 28.0 -- the best offensive environment on this roster's slate this week.
- **Taylor (IND at HOU):** HOU implied 27.25 vs IND's 17.25 -- a sizeable road-underdog spot that leans the game script away from him.
- **Jets D/ST (at LAC):** LAC implied 21.75, an average matchup -- nothing to stream for this week.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 11 (this week):** Matthew Stafford (QB), Jaxon Smith-Njigba (WR), Drake London (WR) -- already reflected in the lineup above.
- **Week 13:** Jonathan Taylor (RB) and the Jets D/ST both sit. Two weeks out, so no specific waiver claim is being recommended yet, but start planning now with only five bench spots -- RJ Harvey (RB, DEN, 8.03 expected / 0.732 play probability / 6 games of data) surfaced on this week's generic waiver list and is a reasonable speculative stash against that RB hole, though he hasn't been evaluated specifically against Week 13's matchups yet.

## Caveats

- No live Week 11 injury/practice data exists anywhere yet -- re-check Wednesday.
- ESPN/Sleeper/Rotowire/FantasyPros all proxy-blocked here; this is a degraded, self-generated run on live nflreadpy data only.
- The committed Week 11 fixture is stale (2026-09-08) and was not used.
- Lineup total (123.47) passes the 100-140 sanity check.
- No week-13 waiver claim is being made yet -- it's early and matchup-dependent.
- Vegas implied totals use nflreadpy's own spread/total convention, not independently cross-checked.
